stories.title: Signing Day Is Here — Class of 2027 Signs on November 11

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Signing Day is here.

November 11, 2026. Class of 2027 softball recruits can sign athletics aid agreements starting today.

No NLI. No fifth-year chaos. Just softball.

Which program's class are you most excited about? #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Five programs most at stake today:

Florida — top-10 class expected
Tennessee — Weekly rebuilds rotation
Oklahoma — adds depth around Wells+Kavan
Texas — defending champion standard
Texas Tech — No. 1 portal class + HS adds

Signing Day is here. #Softball

article.headline: Signing Day Is Here — Five Programs With the Most at Stake on November 11

stories.title: 5-for-5 Creates Signing Day Casualties — Roster Squeeze Forces De-Commits

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The 5-for-5 ruling arrived on Signing Day with consequences.

Memphis pulled offers. Cassidy Ott was involuntarily de-committed.

Kentucky's Rachel Lawson called it months ago: "There's going to be casualties."

Today, that prediction is coming true. #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Two things happening simultaneously on Signing Day:

1. Class of 2027 recruits are signing
2. Some are losing their spots because of 5-for-5

The Tenth Circuit ruling is real. Memphis already pulled offers. ~200 state-court cases continue.

It's a complicated day. #Softball

article.headline: 5-for-5 Creates Signing Day Casualties — Roster Squeeze Forces De-Commits
